svg.title: Single agent full-stack lifecycle in Cognition
svg.desc: A left-to-right lifecycle diagram showing one scoped Agent definition moving through trusted ingress, REST or A2A APIs, durable task creation, runtime resolution, Deep Agents execution, model tools and sandbox calls, event streaming, persistence, optional human approval, completion, and teardown.
svg.text: From a builder-owned definition to a scoped task, one or more run attempts, durable evidence, and teardown
Identity · authorization · tenancy · product lifecycle remain builder-owned
interrupt → waiting → resume same checkpoint thread
traces · metrics · structured logs · runtime events · session/run/task/thread correlation · scope-safe attributes
